basic.name: Ice Crampon Technique
basic.description_template: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Lynx's Max HP to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Salted Camping Cans
skill.description_template: Applies "Survival Response" to a single target ally and increases their Max HP by {{hp_max_boost_pct}}% of Lynx's Max HP plus {{hp_max_boost_flat}}. If the target ally is a character on the Path of Destruction or Preservation, the chance of them being attacked by enemies will greatly increase. "Survival Response" lasts for 2 turn(s). Restores the target's HP by {{hp_restore_pct}}% of Lynx's Max HP plus {{hp_restore_flat}}.

ultimate.name: Snowfield First Aid
ultimate.description_template: Dispels 1 debuff(s) from all allies and immediately restores their respective HP by an amount equal to {{hp_restore_pct}}% of Lynx's Max HP plus {{hp_restore_flat}}.

talent.name: Outdoor Survival Experience
talent.description_template: When using Lynx's Skill or Ultimate, applies continuous healing to the target ally for 2 turn(s), restoring the target ally's HP by an amount equal to {{base_heal_pct}}% of Lynx's Max HP plus {{base_heal_flat}} at the start of each turn. If the target has "Survival Response," the continuous healing effect additionally restores HP by an amount equal to {{sr_bonus_pct}}% of Lynx's Max HP plus {{sr_bonus_flat}}.

technique.name: Chocolate Energy Bar
technique.description: After Lynx uses her Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted her Talent's continuous healing effect, lasting for 2 turn(s).

2.name: Advance Surveying
2.description: After a target with "Survival Response" is hit, Lynx regenerates 2 Energy immediately.

4.name: Exploration Techniques
4.description: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by 35.0%.

6.name: Survival in the Extreme
6.description: Extends the duration of the continuous healing effect granted by Talent for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Morning of Snow Hike
eidolons.description: When healing allies with HP percentage equal to or lower than 50.0%, Lynx's Outgoing Healing increases by 20.0%. This effect also works on continuous healing.

eidolons.name: Noon of Portable Furnace
eidolons.description: A target with "Survival Response" can resist debuff application for 1 time(s).

eidolons.name: Afternoon of Avalanche Beacon
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Dusk of Warm Campfire
eidolons.description: When "Survival Response" is gained, increases the target's ATK by an amount equal to 3.0% of Lynx's Max HP for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Night of Aurora Tea
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Dawn of Explorers' Chart
eidolons.description: Additionally boosts the Max HP increasing effect of "Survival Response" by an amount equal to 6.0% of Lynx's Max HP and increases Effect RES by 30.0%.
